$description: English strings for the aircraft setup wizards, the flight flows, banners and controller settings. Keys are dotted; {name} is replaced by the argument of that name. A missing key renders the key itself.

strings.setup.wizard.ground.title: Aircraft setup
strings.setup.wizard.ground.body: Calibrate the sensors, check the outputs and set the starting parameters. Nothing spins without a hold-confirm.
strings.setup.wizard.air.title: Flight tuning
strings.setup.wizard.air.body: ADOS flies short test flights to measure the aircraft and tune its gains. Move any stick or press PS to take over at any time.
strings.setup.wizard.report.title: Setup report
strings.setup.wizard.revert.title: Revert to snapshot
strings.setup.wizard.revert.body: Restore every parameter from the snapshot taken on {date}.
strings.setup.detect.title: Detect the flight controller
strings.setup.detect.body: Reading the firmware, version and vehicle type.
strings.setup.detect.unsupported: This firmware is not supported by the agent wizard. Use Mission Control's direct-connect setup.
strings.setup.frame.title: Frame
strings.setup.frame.body: Choose the frame layout and enter the propulsion details. They set the starting filters and limits.
strings.setup.frame.body.plane: Choose the wing type. It sets which outputs drive the control surfaces.
strings.setup.frame.body.vtol: Choose the lift-motor layout and the wing type.
strings.setup.accel.title: Accelerometer
strings.setup.accel.body: Place the aircraft in each pose shown, hold it still, then press Next pose.
strings.setup.level.title: Level horizon
strings.setup.level.body: Set the aircraft on a level surface and keep it still.
strings.setup.level.body.plane: Hold the aircraft at its cruise attitude, nose up about {deg}°, and keep it still.
strings.setup.gyro.title: Gyroscope
strings.setup.gyro.body: Keep the aircraft completely still on a level surface.
strings.setup.compass.title: Compass
strings.setup.compass.body: Pick the aircraft up and rotate it slowly through every orientation until each compass reaches 100 %.
strings.setup.compass.retry: Compass fit {fitness} mGauss is above 16. Retry {n} of 3.
strings.setup.compass.large_vehicle: Large vehicle: point the nose at a known heading instead
strings.setup.airspeed.title: Airspeed sensor
strings.setup.airspeed.body: Cover the pitot tube so no wind reaches it, then start.
strings.setup.radio.title: Radio
strings.setup.radio.body: Move every stick and switch through its full range, then centre the sticks and press Done.
strings.setup.rc_ados_switch.title: ADOS switch position
strings.setup.rc_ados_switch.body: Flip the flight-mode switch to the position you want to hand control to ADOS, then press Next. That position will select GUIDED.
strings.setup.outputs.title: Outputs
strings.setup.outputs.body: Each motor spins slowly for 2 seconds. Remove the propellers first.
strings.setup.outputs.body.plane: Each control surface moves in turn. Watch it and answer the question.
strings.setup.question.motor_position: Did motor {n} spin? Is it in the position shown?
strings.setup.question.motor_direction: Is motor {n} spinning the way the arrow shows?
strings.setup.question.surface_aileron_right_up: Does the right aileron go up?
strings.setup.question.surface_aileron_left_up: Does the left aileron go up?
strings.setup.question.surface_elevon_right_up: Does the right elevon go up?
strings.setup.question.surface_elevon_left_up: Does the left elevon go up?
strings.setup.question.surface_vtail_right_up: Does the right V-tail surface go up?
strings.setup.question.surface_vtail_left_up: Does the left V-tail surface go up?
strings.setup.outputs.fix.swap_wires: Swap any two of motor {n}'s three wires, then test it again.
strings.setup.outputs.fix.wrong_position: Motor {n} is wired to the wrong output. Move its signal lead to output {expected}.
strings.setup.battery.title: Battery
strings.setup.battery.body: Measure the battery with a multimeter and enter the voltage.
strings.setup.initial_params.title: Starting parameters
strings.setup.initial_params.body: Filters, limits and motor curve from the propeller size and cell count.
strings.setup.initial_params.body.plane: Enter the airspeeds and cruise throttle. Climb and sink limits start conservative and are measured in flight.
strings.setup.notch_static.title: Vibration filter
strings.setup.notch_static.body: Sets the harmonic notch from the motor RPM telemetry.
strings.setup.notch_static.deferred: No motor telemetry. The filter is set during the first hover.
strings.setup.ados_profile.title: ADOS safety profile
strings.setup.ados_profile.body: Sets the flight controller's failsafes so it returns home if ADOS stops: ground-station heartbeat, guided timeout, battery actions.
strings.setup.ados_intro.title: Meet ADOS Pilot
strings.setup.ados_intro.body:
ADOS flies the aircraft: your sticks, skills and missions go through it, and it holds position, keeps height and avoids obstacles.
The flight controller still stabilises, mixes the motors and runs its own last-resort failsafe.
To take over, move any stick or press PS; to hand back to the flight controller, use the mode chip.
strings.setup.preflight.title: Before flight tuning
strings.setup.preflight.body: Fly over open ground with nothing within {radius} m. Battery at least 80 %.
strings.setup.preflight.open_area: I have at least {radius} m of open space
strings.setup.first_hover.title: First hover
strings.setup.first_hover.body: ADOS takes off to 3 m, hovers for 45 seconds and lands, measuring vibration, hover throttle and attitude error.
strings.setup.first_hover.oscillation: Oscillation detected. Landed. Halve the rate P gains and try again.
strings.setup.first_flight.title: First flight
strings.setup.first_flight.body: ADOS takes off, loiters at 80 m for 60 seconds, and measures cruise throttle, tracking and airspeed.
strings.setup.first_flight.body.vtol: ADOS hovers for 45 seconds, transitions to forward flight and back.
strings.setup.notch_air.title: Vibration filter (in flight)
strings.setup.notch_air.body: Sets a throttle-based notch from the learned hover throttle.
strings.setup.trim_air.title: Trim
strings.setup.trim_air.body: Level flight for 30 seconds while the surfaces trim themselves.
strings.setup.airspeed_cal.title: Airspeed calibration
strings.setup.airspeed_cal.body: A 2-minute loiter while the airspeed ratio is learned.
strings.setup.tecs_measure.title: Climb and sink
strings.setup.tecs_measure.body: Full-throttle climb, idle glide and a fast dive to measure the climb and sink limits.
strings.setup.autotune.title: Autotune
strings.setup.autotune.body: ADOS holds the aircraft nose into the wind at 8 m while the flight controller twitches each axis. Keep the sticks centred; move them only to reposition.
strings.setup.autotune.body.plane: ADOS flies roll and pitch doublets inside the tuning area until each axis is tuned.
strings.setup.autotune.body.vtol: Tunes the lift motors in hover first, then the wing in forward flight.
strings.setup.autotune.yaw_later: Battery too low for yaw. Landed and saved. Swap the battery to tune yaw.
strings.setup.verify.title: Verify
strings.setup.verify.body: A tuned hover and a 3 m/s box, compared with the first hover.
strings.setup.verify.body.plane: Bank and climb steps, compared with the first flight.
strings.setup.verify.worse: The tune is worse on {axis} by {pct} %. Revert the gains?
strings.setup.blocker.readiness: Clear the red readiness items first
strings.setup.blocker.wind_high: Wind {wind} m/s is too strong (limit {limit} m/s)
strings.setup.err.fc_timeout: The flight controller did not answer
strings.setup.err.fc_rejected: The flight controller refused the command
strings.readiness.fc_profile: Flight controller failsafes not set for ADOS
strings.readiness.mission_inferred: FC firmware < 4.5: mission state is inferred
strings.flow.launch.title: Launch
strings.flow.plane_land_hint: RTH to land: configure a landing in the mission
strings.flow.preflight.title: Pre-flight checklist
strings.flow.low_battery.title: Low battery: returning home in {in_s} s
strings.flow.low_battery.cancel_warning: Cancelling may leave too little charge to land.
strings.pilot.banner.fc_control: FC has control · {mode} · PS to take back
strings.pilot.banner.low_battery_rth: Low battery: returning home in {in_s} s
strings.pilot.avoid.fixedwing_note: Fixed-wing: obstacle avoidance applies only as a minimum height above ground.
strings.skill.picker.title: Skills
strings.skill.key_conflict: {skill} has no key: {key} is already bound to {other}
strings.controls.title: Controls
strings.controls.press_any_button: Press any button on the controller
strings.controls.locked: Safety binding: it can be moved, not removed
strings.controls.import.missing_locked: This file is missing safety bindings: {actions}
strings.controls.calibrate.title: Calibrate sticks
strings.controls.calibrate.body: Move both sticks to every edge, then let go.
strings.controls.test.lightbar_unavailable: This platform can't set the lightbar colour
strings.controls.tour.sticks.title: Sticks
strings.controls.tour.sticks.body: Left stick: climb and turn. Right stick: fly forward, back and sideways. Centred sticks hold position.
strings.controls.tour.safety.title: Safety
strings.controls.tour.safety.body: PS brakes; hold it 2 s to return home. Hold L1 + R1 to arm. L2 + R2 + Circle for 3 s is the emergency stop.
strings.controls.tour.skills.title: Skills
strings.controls.tour.skills.body: D-pad picks a skill and tunes it, Cross starts it, Circle stops it.
